snippet.title: [EVILBANE] Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the official trailer for EVILBANE.

Your moment of victory is short-lived, as an even stronger boss appears and the never-ending war continues.

EVILBANE delivers strategic and adrenaline-pumping action you can take on alone or with your allies.
Freely switch between melee and ranged weapons, customize skills to fit each situation, and play with a character built your way.

🔗 Official Website: https://evilbane.netmarble.com
🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/EVILBANE

#Netmarble #EVILBANE #ActionRPG
